concerns.text: Task T015a ('Write data-model.md') is placed AFTER T012-T016 (Implementation of ingestion/rasterization). This violates the 'Foundational tasks first' principle. The data model (reprojection/resampling methods) must be defined BEFORE the code that implements it (T014) to ensure the implementation matches the spec. T015a should be in Phase 2 (Foundational).

Task T032 ('Implement Proxy Validity Sensitivity') depends on T032a ('Fetch literature-derived upper bounds'). While T032a is listed before T032, T032a is placed in Phase 5 (US3) alongside the modeling tasks. The literature bounds are a static reference required for the sensitivity calculation logic. To ensure the logic in T032 is testable and correct, the data source (T032a) should be established as a foundational data artifact or at least strictly before the modeling logic is written, not as a concurrent task in the same block.

Task T021 ('Generate EDA summary report') includes 'Attempt to ingest socioeconomic proxies'. This ingestion logic is a data dependency that should be a distinct task or part of the ingestion phase (US1) if it produces a new artifact. Embedding ingestion logic inside a reporting task (T021) creates a hidden dependency and violates the 'Producer before consumer' flow, as the report depends on data that may not exist or be processed yet.

The test tasks (T009-T011) are listed under 'Tests for User Story 1' but are not explicitly ordered relative to the implementation tasks (T012-T016) in the dependency list. While the text says 'Write these tests FIRST', the task list structure implies a flat list. To strictly respect the 'Tests MUST be written and FAIL before implementation' rule, the test tasks should be visually or structurally ordered before the implementation tasks in the dependency graph.
